ITEM 1 | Bright yellow-orange mashed mass with a slightly granular, fluffy texture and small pale flecks, mounded in the upper right of the plate, roughly 7 cm across and 2 cm high, sitting beside the white block to its right | 90
ITEM 2 | Creamy white, soft crumbly curd-like pieces with a moist, slightly glossy surface, clustered in the center-right of the plate, covering roughly 35 percent of the plate in an irregular mound about 3 cm high, with a few larger smooth white chunks at its edge | 150
ITEM 3 | Pale white smooth solid block with a firm, slightly waxy surface and clean-cut edges, lying at the upper right edge and along the lower right of the plate, pieces about 4 by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick | 60
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown diced pieces with crisp, browned and slightly charred edges and darker caramelized spots, cut into irregular cubes about 1.5 to 2 cm, forming a dense cluster of roughly 9 by 7 cm in the lower left of the plate, with some oily sheen | 85
ITEM 5 | Single small golden-brown cube with a browned crust, about 1.5 cm, sitting alone in the upper center of the plate, dry-looking surface | 5
